<Heading

>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reports/receiving-performance"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



How is the dock performing? `days[]` has one row per UTC calendar day
intersecting `[from, to)` (zeros included); a day's counts cover the
part of the day inside the range. `receipts_closed`, `discrepancies`
and `receipt_cycle` follow the receipt's `ReceiptClosed` time;
`lines_received` counts the receiving actions (`ReceiptLineReceived`)
and `units_good` / `units_damaged` sum their quantities by condition.
`receipt_cycle` (open to close) and `dock_dwell` (check-in to
completed) include only receipts and appointments whose opening or
check-in the projection also saw; their `p50_seconds` / `p95_seconds`
are linear-interpolated percentiles and are null when `count` is 0.
`appointments` counts each milestone that fell in the window. The
`appointments` and `dock_dwell` blocks are FROZEN since ADR 0019: the
appointment moved to dock-scheduling, so nothing new feeds them.

`dock_to_stock` (ADR 0021) is the time from the carrier's gate arrival
(yard-management's `VisitCheckedIn`) to the stow of the last Good
carton (inventory-storage's `ContainerStowed`) of the receipts whose
`ReceiptStowCompleted` fell in the window (a fact counts in the UTC day
of its `stowed_at`). `p50_seconds` is the median and `p90_seconds` the
90th percentile (linear-interpolated); `under_target` counts the
facts at or under `dock_to_stock_target_seconds` (11160 s = 3.1 h, the
WERC best-in-class) and `share_under_target` is `under_target / count`.
The percentiles and the share are null when `count` is 0. A receipt
without an appointment arrival (a walk-in) or without cartons has no
dock-to-stock and is not counted.

`advice` (ADR 0023) counts the receiving advices (`ReceivingAdviceIssued`)
issued in the window (a fact counts in the UTC day of its `issued_at`):
`count`, `within_sla` (issued inside the committed window after the last
unit received) and `share_within_sla` (`within_sla / count`, null when
`count` is 0). Receipts closed before the advice existed have none.

`current` is the state right now, independent of the range:
`open_receipts` (opened, not yet closed), `expected_today` (ASNs not
cancelled whose expected arrival falls in today's UTC day) and
`expected_today_started` (those with a receipt already opened). The
data is as fresh as `GET /reports/freshness` says.
